description: The plot titled “Whisper fine-tunning, type = tiny” shows word error rate (WER) across fine-tuning epochs for five different tiny-model weight/quantization setups. The x-axis is labeled “epoch” and uses a linear scale from 0 to 6 with integer tick marks at every 1 epoch. The y-axis is labeled “WER” and uses a linear scale spanning approximately 20 to 70, with labeled ticks at 30, 40, 50, 60, and 70. The “tiny AdaLoRA_int4” series is drawn as a solid gray line with circular markers, decreasing from about 69 at epoch 0 to about 60 (epoch 1), ~55 (epoch 2), ~45 (epoch 3), ~40 (epoch 4), ~37 (epoch 5), and ~36–37 by epoch 6. The “tiny AdaLoRA_int8” series is a solid gray line with square markers, moving from about 60 at epoch 0 to ~51 (epoch 1), ~50 (epoch 2), ~43 (epoch 3), ~39 (epoch 4), ~36 (epoch 5), and ~32 at epoch 6. The “tiny int4” series is a dashed gray line with circular markers, going from about 68–69 at epoch 0 to ~56 (epoch 1), ~50 (epoch 2), ~44 (epoch 3), ~39–40 (epoch 4), ~39–40 (epoch 5), and ~40 at epoch 6. The “tiny int8” series is a dashed gray line with square markers, decreasing from about 59–60 at epoch 0 to ~47 (epoch 1), ~46 (epoch 2), ~43 (epoch 3), ~37–38 (epoch 4), ~37 (epoch 5), and ~37 at epoch 6. The “tiny full” series is a dotted gray line with triangle markers, starting around 29 at epoch 0 and moving through ~27–28 (epoch 1), ~27 (epoch 2), ~24 (epoch 3), ~24 (epoch 4), ~23–24 (epoch 5), and ~23 at epoch 6.
